name: react-resource-capacity-planner
title: Resource Capacity Planner
shortDescription: Read-only room and shared-resource capacity planner using bounded SharePoint REST sources.
longDescription: Shows daily and weekly utilization, capacity, deterministic overlap conflicts, and available working-hour slots.
Uses current-user and list GET requests through an injectable SPHttpClient abstraction. It never creates, updates, or cancels bookings.

references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part
